Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full rebate-offers payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Rebates you qualify for","subtitle":"Save on energy-efficient upgrades","currency":"USD","offers":[{"id":"thermostat","name":"Smart thermostat","category":"thermostat","rebateAmount":75,"detail":"ENERGY STAR models","badge":"Popular"},{"id":"heatpump","name":"Heat pump HVAC","category":"heat_pump","rebateAmount":1200,"detail":"Whole-home system"},{"id":"evcharger","name":"Level 2 EV charger","category":"ev_charger","rebateAmount":500,"detail":"Install included"},{"id":"insulation","name":"Attic insulation","category":"insulation","rebateAmount":350,"detail":"Up to R-49"}],"submitText":"Apply for rebate","submitValue":"Apply for the rebate"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Rebates you qualify for'. - 'subtitle' (string, optional): one short line under the title. - 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code, default USD. - 'offers' (array, REQUIRED): each { 'id' (string, REQUIRED — sent back on selection); 'name' (string, REQUIRED); 'category' (string, optional — one of thermostat | hvac | heat_pump | ev_charger | solar | insulation | water_heater | appliance; drives the tile glyph); 'rebateAmount' (number, optional — shown large in the voucher stub); 'detail' (string, optional — one short line); 'badge' (string, optional — small corner tag e.g. 'Popular') }. - 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Apply for rebate'. The customer taps a voucher to select it, then this button applies. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the chosen offer name when sending back. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
